# PKC Events

> Professional wedding planning, luxury catering, and event management services across Kerala since 2008. Certified under ISO 22000:2018 for food safety and licensed by FSSAI.

PKC Events (Pride Kitchen Caterers & Events) provides complete wedding planning, corporate event management, luxury catering, venue decoration, and hospitality solutions across Kerala.

## Main Pages
- [Home](/): Official homepage and overview of PKC Events
- [About Us](/about): Story, leadership team, ISO certifications, and company milestones
- [Services](/services): Complete event management and catering services
- [Menu Selection](/menu): Interactive 32-page catering menu selection with live juices, biryanis, live counters, and grand sadhya spreads
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Signature portfolio of luxury weddings, corporate galas, and catering banquets
- [Gallery](/gallery): Portfolio and photos of luxury weddings, receptions, and celebrations
- [Blog](/blog): Wedding planning guides, catering tips, and event inspiration
- [Contact](/contact): Book a consultation and enquiry form

## Services
- [Premium Catering](/services/catering): Luxury wedding, corporate, and private catering

- [Photography & Video](/services/photography): Cinematic wedding photography and film

- [Luxury Cars](/services/cars): Premium wedding and VIP car rentals
